target_customer: Financial services and fintech firms onboarding business customers (KYB)
problem: Onboarding business customers needs slow manual data entry and compliance checks.
business_model: B2B SaaS for onboarding and case management

founders.name: Parinaz Firozi
founders.background_notes: Per third party profile; later joined Stripe in 2021

technical_complexity.rationale: Forms, rule engines and third party check integrations are standard engineering for a two person team.

defensibility.rationale: Onboarding workflow tools were easy to replicate and incumbents already sold KYB checks.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Established identity verification vendors already covered the wedge; no acquisition found.

market_need_then: Regulatory KYC and KYB obligations created demand in financial services in 2019 to 2020.

brand_strength.rationale: No brand press found; similar names (Zams) exist.

outcome_analysis: Zaam was a two person YC W20 startup building business onboarding software that raised roughly 200 thousand dollars according to one aggregator. The directory lists it as inactive but no shutdown post-mortem or announcement was found, so the cause is not public. The failure factors are inferred from tiny funding and entrenched KYB vendors and carry low confidence.
notes: Cause of inactivity not public. Funding 200K over 3 rounds from CB Insights only, so unverified and not recorded as rounds except the Aug 2020 Vcheck Global item (amount unknown). One profile says Firozi led company to raise 2M, conflicting. Competitors dated near batch not found; Trulioo appears only in an undated CB Insights compare page. Exit type unknown, status Inactive per YC.
